faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Mill Valley?
faq.answer: Mill Valley homeowners typically invest $8,500 to $20,000 for a full window replacement project. This beloved Marin County town features a mix of Craftsman bungalows in the downtown flats, modern hillside homes with redwood canyon views, and contemporary residences. Projects vary widely based on window count and custom specifications. Single window installation starts at approximately $650.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Mill Valley?
faq.answer: Yes. Mill Valley requires a building permit for window replacements. Hillside projects may also require additional review for fire safety compliance under the city's planning codes. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Mill Valley?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Mill Valley commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Mill Valley?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Mill Valley replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Mill Valley?
faq.answer: Most Mill Valley projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
